sources_read.label: football/altitude/sources/research_package_venues.csv — the altitude research package venue rows, with their own citations

policy.key: the schedule feed venue_id: a game is located by the venue it was played in, never by the home team
policy.precedence: public provider value first; the research package fills only what no provider carries

confidence.HIGH: public provider value, all sources within 100 ft
confidence.MEDIUM: research-package value only (not re-verified here), or sources 100-300 ft apart
confidence.LOW: sources more than 300 ft apart — never used for an adjustment

policy.missing: a venue without a sourced elevation is absent from `venues`; consumers report it as unavailable and never impute one
policy.inherited_geography: venue ids sharing one provider coordinate pair are resolved by the schedule: the id with the latest home game is current, the others are legacy ids whose provider elevation describes their successor and is never used as theirs
